text.brief: On October 13, 2022, Peng Lifa hung banners from the Sitong Bridge in Beijing that called for elections and an end to lockdowns.
text.record: Police detained him within minutes, and he has not appeared in public since. His slogans spread from phone to phone by AirDrop, which lets nearby devices share files without a network. In November Apple limited AirDrop's open setting to ten minutes on phones sold in the People's Republic. After a fire in Urumqi killed at least ten people on November 24, protests spread to more than a dozen cities, and demonstrators held up blank sheets of paper.
text.reading: Apple did not say why the change reached mainland phones first, and the timing served the Party whether or not it asked. A feature that let people speak without a network lost its reach weeks before the largest protests in decades, which is Stratagem 19.
text.gapText: Technology Architecture. A channel that worked without a network depended on one company's choices, and that company built its phones inside the Party's reach.
text.fix: Require American technology firms to disclose feature changes made for a single country, with the date and the reason.
